research_rationale:
EO 12503 (Presidential Commission on Outdoor Recreation Resources Review), signed 1985-01-28. The order establishes the Presidential Commission on Outdoor Recreation Resources Review (Section 1), its review functions and a report due twelve months after the order (Section 2), administration (Section 3) and general provisions (Section 4). EO 12529 (1985-08-14) renamed it the President's Commission on Americans Outdoors and replaced Section 4(b), whose original text ended the Commission 30 days after its report or on March 1, 1986, whichever was sooner, with a report date of December 31, 1986 and termination 30 days after the report. First end: Section 3(e) of EO 12610 (Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees, signed 1987-09-30, 52 FR 36901-36902) names Executive Order No. 12503 among the orders revoked, and Section 5 makes that order effective September 30, 1987, so the revocation took effect on 1987-09-30. The same section describes the listed orders as ones that established committees which have terminated or whose work is completed; that recital is disclosed as context and as a possible earlier cessation, but it gives no date and is not an end.
